reuse.why: Extends the two existing month-wide selection helpers (getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions and getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage) with one new fixed-group helper both call.

duplication.why: Tag detection is defined once; the only repetition is the json_each group clause in the two pre-existing parallel queries, which the diff keeps in sync rather than merging.

placement.why: The rule sits beside the month-wide selection helpers in budget/actions.ts, though the helper returns a JSON string shaped for SQL json_each, leaking query encoding into its interface.

scope.why: Only the selection rule, tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: One definition of a fixed group is good, but the JSON-string return, a LIKE prefilter plus regex, and two inverse queries (IN vs NOT IN) to keep aligned make it fiddlier than needed.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Both month-wide selection paths take the fixed groups from getFixedCostGroupIdsJson.

disguised_duplication.where: The group clause appears once per existing query, in inverted form as each query needs, not as hidden copied logic.

one_place.where: getFixedCostGroupIdsJson in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by getCategoryIdsExcludedFromMonthWideActions (copy, zero) and getCategoriesForMonthWideAverage (averages, last month).
